title: Monomial spans of subsets in a group algebra
statement: Let $Q$ be a commutative additive monoid, $G$ an abelian group, and $h:Q\to G$ a monoid homomorphism. Set $D=\mathbf Z[Q]$. Let $A_h$ be $\mathbf Z[G]$ regarded as a $D$-module by restriction of scalars along the ring homomorphism induced by $h$, so that $z^q z^t=z^{h(q)+t}$. For any subset $T\subseteq G$, define its monomial span $L_h(T)\subseteq A_h$ to be the $D$-submodule spanned by the monomials $z^t$ with $t\in T$. In particular, for $T+h(Q)\subseteq T$ this is the free abelian group $\mathbf Z[T]$ with the translation action, and the empty subset has zero span.
